guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：檢索增強生成知識平台
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Retrieval-augmented generation platforms
guides.concept: 以檢索、神經生成與證據忠實度串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect retrieval, neural generation and evidence faithfulness with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「來源可用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資料許可權」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：檢索候選需在生成前依使用者許可權過濾。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用假資料角色檢查私有切片不進提示。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「再排序模型」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交叉編碼器比較查詢與檔案對，成本隨候選數增加。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫雙塔與交叉編碼器的計算路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「提示信任」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源內容是資料，不能自動提升為系統指令。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「引用對齊」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：每項宣告需對應支援它的段落與條件。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「逐句檢查合成答案與手冊內容。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「迴歸題集」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：題集需包含矛盾、許可權、未知與數值邊界。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for source usability. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data permissions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Candidates are permission-filtered before generation. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Verify fictional private chunks never enter unauthorized prompts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reranking models. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cross-encoders score query-document pairs with candidate-dependent cost. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw dual-encoder and cross-encoder computation paths. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for prompt trust. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Source content is data, not automatically system authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for citation alignment. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each claim maps to supporting passages and conditions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check each synthetic claim against the manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for regression queries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tests include contradictions, permissions, unknowns and numeric boundaries. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build eight reproducible questions from self-made data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「延遲拆解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只看生成速度便代表整體服務速度。」為何不成立。
提交「迴歸題集」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製資料建立可重算的八題題集。」如何辨別它們。
提交「迴歸題集」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for latency decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Generation speed equals total service speed.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for regression queries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for regression queries; explain why this claim fails: Easy questions alone validate RAG.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：只測容易回答問題即可驗收 RAG。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Easy questions alone validate RAG. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: RAG 原始研究把外部檢索與參數化生成組合；本課將檢索、生成、引用驗收分開，避免把流暢答案當證據。
history.textEn: Original RAG research combines external retrieval with parametric generation; this course separately accepts retrieval, generation and citations.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
